*F-fairSFE* (Guaranteed output delivery) is part of *Layer 6: Secret Sharing, Threshold Cryptography, MPC* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Gordon, Liu, and Shi. [*Constant-round MPC with fairness and guarantee of output delivery*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2015/371). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2015, volume 9216 of LNCS, pages 63–82, 2015.
- Goldwasser and Levin. [*Fair computation of general functions in presence of immoral majority*](https://doi.org/10.1007/3-540-38424-3_6). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 1990, volume 537 of LNCS, 1990.
- Hirt and Maurer. [*Complete characterization of adversaries tolerable in secure multi-party computation*](https://crypto.ethz.ch/publications/files/HirMau00.pdf). Journal of Cryptology, 13(1):31–60, 2000.
